changelog: Module 4: new ARROBO_CO_MAIL_FROM_DOMAIN constant to override the noreply@<domain> domain — for sites whose verified email-sending domain is a subdomain (best practice for transactional mail). Policy 'woo' redesigned: registers at priority 1 instead of bailing out, so WP core emails (password reset, etc.) get noreply@ as fallback instead of WP's wordpress@<domain> default that breaks Resend and other providers requiring a verified sender.
